text:
Sana Ibrahim: Quick heads-up — running a "Manager Nom Drop-In" next Thu 11am-1pm to help managers fill spot-award forms and hand off small plaques. Need volunteers to man the table and someone from payroll to confirm taxable treatment and timing of payouts.
Kev O'Neill: I can do the first hour (11-12). Where should I pick up the plaques?
Sana Ibrahim: Plaques are at Mailroom A, package #M-22. @Dana can you confirm engraving is done?
Dana Lopez: Engraving finished yesterday. I checked the proofs. I'll pick up and bring a spare Sharpie and tape.
Priya Rao: I can cover 12-1. Happy to help managers with the nomination form. Do we have physical copies?
Sana Ibrahim: Yes — 50 printed nomination cards and a stack of pre-addressed envelopes for mailing to execs. Also want a short checklist for managers when they submit a spot award (to avoid missing info).
Kev O'Neill: Can we add a one-pager checklist like: recipient name, contribution summary, approver sign, desired payout (if any), tax category? Keeps forms clean.
Ben (payroll-bot): Payroll note: Spot awards are taxable income. Please submit payment requests using the PAY_REQ flow within 3 business days. Reference required: PAY_REQ: manager-spot-2026-03. Federal withholding handled on next payroll cycle unless marked as 'deferred' per payroll policy. Link: https://redwood.internal/payroll/policy
Priya Rao: Thanks Ben. For managers who want immediate gift cards instead of payout, is that different?
Ben (payroll-bot): Gift cards are still taxable. Treat as cash-equivalent in payroll. If you need an itemized report: request code `GC-REPORT-2026` via the payroll portal.
Sana Ibrahim: Great. Volunteers: @Kev 11-12, @Priya 12-1, @Dana pickup plaques and bring tape/sharpie. Need one more person for shadowing and to scan completed cards into the recognition tracker.
Kev O'Neill: I'll bring my phone with the scanner app.
Dana Lopez: I'll put the scanning folder in Drive and share link in the event.
Sana Ibrahim: Created calendar event: "Manager Nom Drop-In" Thu 11:00-13:00. Link: https://calendar.redwood/event/manager-nom-dropin. Please RSVP. Also: expense reminder for plaque pickup — submit within 7 days.
Ben (payroll-bot): Expense compliance: use expense code `POPUP-MGR-2026`. Receipt required for plaques and any postage.
Priya Rao: One more Q — do managers need to attach a short impact blurb for awards that go into the public recognition feed?
Sana Ibrahim: Yes — add a 1-2 sentence impact blurb. We'll post with recipient consent. Template in the event notes.
Kev O'Neill: All set. See you Thu. :smile:
Sana Ibrahim: Thanks team — I'll post a reminder Wed evening and print the checklist tomorrow.
